D.t: Steven Horsford leads by 21.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 65,910 votes; a one point swing is about 1,520 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +14.0 and D +28.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.5M cash against $285K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
